method: Two manual semantic passes per output; delegated same-team nonblind review on roots00-03, owning session roots04-07 and adjudication of misses. Not independent research signoff. Exact hashes verified with T1 scorer.
adjudication: Retain strict integrated scope/modality interpretation. Report lenient content-preservation sensitivity rather than cherry-pick labels. Unsupported remaining-material review assertion blocks the conservative no-critical-addition screen; prototype uncertainty, historical time and unavailable-receipt controls remain explicit.
